summary: Static code review of Souvera Shield Nextcloud app v2.3.1. No PHP/Nextcloud runtime available in sandbox — verified all acceptance criteria via source inspection (routes.php ↔ DmarcController match, template ↔ CSS class match, JS data-label ↔ CSS ::before rule, and absence of removed methods/routes/handlers). All 15 acceptance criteria are met. Only two very minor code-smell observations found; no blockers.

minor.issue: Method findActive() (line 36) is still defined but no longer referenced from any controller/service/job. Dead code — can be safely deleted (leftover from the multi-domain era).

issues: The class .shield-table__col-action is declared twice (line 235 and line 285-288). Both rules are consistent (width:1%; white-space:nowrap) so it is not user-visible, but one of the two declarations should be removed to satisfy DRY. Task explicitly asked about the .shield-table__col-check duplicate which IS fixed (only line 236 remains).

action_items: OPTIONAL: Remove the duplicate .shield-table__col-action rule at /app/css/style.css lines 285-288 (line 235 already carries the same declaration).
OPTIONAL: Delete the now-unused DmarcDomainMapper::findActive() method (/app/lib/Db/DmarcDomainMapper.php line 36) since the reputation refactor no longer iterates over multiple domains.

context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a Nextcloud PHP app; the sandbox has neither PHP CLI nor a running Nextcloud, so all testing must be static. Live testing happens on the user's Nextcloud 34 instance after deployment. All source paths follow OCP\SouveraShield namespace under /app/lib/. Two optional cleanups noted (duplicate .shield-table__col-action CSS rule and unused DmarcDomainMapper::findActive method) — neither blocks release of v2.3.1.
rca of the issue: Original bug: table columns had no explicit width so `table-layout: fixed` could not distribute space, producing cramped layouts. Fix: (1) added shield-table__col-* modifier classes on every <th> in main.php with concrete widths in style.css; (2) added .shield-table--stackable modifier + @media(max-width:640px) card layout using td::before { content:attr(data-label) }; (3) JS renderers set data-label on every <td> so the ::before rule shows column labels on mobile; (4) removed the sticky-header rule that caused theme artifacts. Structural refactor: replaced multi-domain UI with a single configuration-sourced managed domain (ManagedDomainService), so users cannot pick the domain — it comes from app-config `provider_tools_domain` or PMG's first allowed domain.
